ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad high-intensity white regions on the lateral lobes with a dense low-intensity dark-grey region centered around the median notch and extending along the trailing edges; dark linear streaks are superimposed on the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 105 degrees; vertex is sharply defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular boundary with frequent micro-serrations and several prominent indentations (5-15 pixel depth) particularly on the upper-left trailing margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex outer curvature tapering to rounded tips, transitioning to an irregular concave path toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters (2-8 pixels) localized on the outer left lobe and scattered sparsely within the white fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Complex network of dark, intersecting linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible across the white pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive multi-directional linear scarring (rake marks) across the visible ventral fluke surface.
